-- Phase 1: spec only. Bodies are placeholders until Phase 2.

-- Pure formatter: no capabilities, so it cannot touch fs or io.
format_line(level: str, message: str) -> str =
  pre level.char_count() > 0
  post out.char_count() >= message.char_count() + 3
  ex format_line("INFO", "started") == "[INFO] started"
  "[\(level)] \(message)"

-- Prints one formatted line. Only io is granted; fs is not declared.
log_line(level: str, message: str) uses io =
  pre level.char_count() > 0
  io.print(format_line(level: level, message: message))
